page.layout: One column of running text in the centre; notes in the left margin (two blocks, upper and lower). Running head at top centre; page number at top left. Right edge shows part of the neighbouring page, not transcribed.

main_text.p: Imperio suo subjecerunt: Unde hodieq; tota Hispaniae Nobilitas originem suam deducit à Westgothis.
Hoc regnum Westgothicum Subjiciuntur à Mauris, in Hispania destructum fuit à Mauris.

A. C, 713. sub ultimo Rege Gothorum Roderico. Causa fuit hujus calamitatis, quod Rodericus Cavam, Juliani Comitis Mauritaniae filiam, stuprasset. Quapropter Julianus, ut sumeret ultionem de Roderico, Saracenos ex Mauritania ad Hispaniam occupandam evocavit, qui vi-ctoRoderico universa breviter tempore potiti sunt Hispaniā.
main_text.head: Periodus II.
main_text.p: Gothi quinque regna per Hispaniam pulsis Mauris instaurarunt. quos ta-men ite-rum pul-sant & regna e-rigunt. Ex-

page.notes: Left margin note at the top reads "Subjiciuntur à Mauris," with its first letters partly obscured; transcribed as printed. Lower left note "qvos ta / men ite / rum pul / sant & / regna e- / rigunt" is set in small type with its word-breaks uncertain; the joining of "ta-men ite-rum" is a reconstruction from the line breaks. "713" in the Explic. paragraph is read from a slightly blurred numeral. The "38" page number is printed in an old form and is read as 38. "Ex-" ends the page as a hyphenated fragment carried over to the next page.
